[h1][b]Some info on 'Departments'![/b][/h1]

[b]Thank you![/b]

notes.title: Dev Update [08.10.2017]
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Departments are almost here![/b][/h1]

Good evening/afternoon/morning Everyone!

It's been a while since we gave you guys a dev update, so we thought we'd put one together today. Departments are getting along nicely and we would like to present some of it to you [u]today.[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26360995/759dcab13f95f6f03eca9d7066c74ea5fe99a6fd.png[/img]

This is what is currently looks like. [i](Look, it's even night time!)[/i]

The screenshot still has a couple of placeholders, but you get the idea. You can create your own departments, consisting of rooms and employees. It's very important to think through your shift schedule, so that you have the right staff for the right times, in the right places.

There are still some mechanics that needs implementing, like how to control where the pasient should be forwarded at which times. This is something the player will have to set up themselves for each department.

If you have any questions regarding departments, we're more than happy to answer them!

Oh and we just released a patch for Hospitalize, featuring some fixes regarding saving & loading of milestones. You can check that out [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/503370/announcements/detail/1467469902643913875]here[/url]

[b]Now[/b], we would really like to ask the ones of you who work/have worked or have experience with medicine,  what kind of aspects or mechanics, diseases or treatments you would like to see in Hospitalize. Maybe something you can relate to or something you have experience with. Let us know and we're more than happy to look over them and see what we can do!

That's about it for now. Expect departments to hit the Experimental branch soon, where you will be able to test it before it's even released to the public! We're always super greatful to anyone who tests and reports issues, it helps [b]a lot![/b]

We'll see you next time!


[b]Thank you![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.notes:
[h1][b]Weekly.. more like monthly, am I right??[/b][/h1]

Hello everyone! Finally time for another update regarding everything Hospitalize, but first: Here are changelogs for the latest Hospitalize patch.

Huge "thank you" to everyone on the Experimental branch for testing as always!

[h1][b]CHANGELOG:[/b][/h1]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a patient spawn error.
[*] Fixed multiple issues with 'Milestones' and game progress in general.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused characters to freeze.

Small, but [i]important[/i] patch! Onto the dev update:

Right now, we feel like the tutorial isn't really doing what it's supposed to and we'll be releasing a fix on this the coming week. In the long run, we want to have a stable and intuitive system, but it's important that it doesn't hinder the player either like it's been doing as of lately.

[b]Work on departments has begun![/b] This is a major update and will be gradually more available on the 'Experimental branch'. The first update will be released in a few weeks and will include a day / night cycle as well as shifts. Very exciting!

First sketch:

A couple weeks or so ago we released a survey which we asked you all to take part of. This got overwhelmingly better response than we would've thought and more than 200 of you answered it! Thank you!

One of the more important questions were "What do you think we should focous on moving forward?" and not so suprisingly, it was 'Departments' who got the most votes, but it was also important for us to see what other topics you are interested in and this certainly helped us a lot!

That's it for this time, thank you all very much for taking part of this forum and helping us make Hospitalize an even greater game! We appreciate it a lot!

We'll see you next time!


[b]Thank you![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update [15.08.2017] - Week 17
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Vacations over, more Hospitalize![/b][/h1]

Summer is nearing its end, holidays are over and it's time to focus on going forward!

The content of the [i]experimental branch[/i] is getting ready. We will initially work to get this in place. Bugs will be removed and the content balanced and polished. Milestones work well and we have received good feedback, but more variation and customization is needed before the complete feature is done. Pathfinding has been completely replaced and has become much better. We have received a lot of feedback with bugged savegames. Efforts to correct these errors have begun.

Furthermore, we will begin the work with [b]departments.[/b] This will give players completely new challenges, and it will be even more important to think about how to build their hospital. An effective flow of patients through the hospital will give positive results, while ineffectiveness will be devastating to the hospital. Which is why we're also including schedules and day/night cycles into this update, making the game a lot more "real". Departments will of course be the entrance to multiple content upgrades with different themes. We are starting with the administration department, for which artwork is already in production! 

This summer, plans for [u]endgame[/u] started to take shape and we will work on it later this year. We can't tell too much, as it is still very fresh; But the idea is that the player will be able to bring the result or product from his hospital to a new level in the game and strengthen his position here by building new, better and [b]more hospitals![/b]


[b]Thanks![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update [16.07.2017] - Week 16
notes.notes:
[h1][b]A bit *caugh* delayed, but worth it![/b][/h1]


A little bit slow of a week. We launched an update featuring some bugfixes and optimalization and have been following the forums and bug reports closely like always. An update featuring more fixes is in the works for some time this week. As summer is upon us, it is time for us to take a little bit of a vacation. We'll always be available and will probably cram in a little work here and there, but expect a little slower time going forward and into the next week.

But before that! We have some news regarding the [i]'Experiemental Branch'[/i].

By the end of [b]tomorrow[/b], we will have launched a separate subforum here on Steam which will be dedicated to the experimental branch. There will be some guidelines, and a thread featuring changelogs regarding the updates that hits the branch. This forum will also be a place where people who decide to play there can post issues regarding [u]only[/u] the experimental branch, so that it's easier for us to seperate problems between the main branch and the experimental one.

Keep in mind that this forum will contain spoilers regarding upcoming updates, as that is what the experimental branch is for. So for those of you who do not wish to participate, we'd suggest [u]not[/u] going there if you don't want information about the newest updates [i]spoiled[/i] to you :]

It's gonna be real exciting! We're looking forward to it. Oh and, you can expect brand new stuff coming to the experimental branch some time this week. Should be [b]awesome![/b] We'll see you then!


[b]Thanks![/b] 
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update [09.07.2017] - Week 15
notes.notes:
[h1][b]New weekly update![/b][/h1]


Thank you everyone for every nice and new feedback! It means a lot to us and really helps taking the development in the right direction.

We've noticed that many of you would like a more stable version of the game and some wants more experimental versions featuring new things. We have launched an experimental version before and will do so again as we think it's very crucial that everyone who wants to can hop in and test new features immidiately if they wish, as well as having the option to jump into a properly stable version. Last time we launched the experimental version we had tons of amazing feedback and helped tremendously towards releasing to the stable version.

We have much more content planned for the game, but it is also important to have a natural progression. In order for not all content to become "overwhelming" in the beginning, we will introduce a system that unlocks parts of the game along the way. Initially, one will relate to few diagnoses, rooms and other game features, but will unlock more through completing certain goals or what we like to call "Milestones".

As always, bug reports sent in through the in-game 'Bug report' tool are extremely helpful and really is one of our strongest weapons against bugs. All bug reporting and suggestions are very much appreciated. Fixing bugs and optimalizing is still number one priority and will continue to be the main focus.

We'll see you next week!


[b]Thank you!![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

[h1][b]Closing in, slowly but surely.[/b][/h1]

Right now, the game doesn't have a very good way of explaining the player how to actually play it. The 'Doctors handbook' has always been there, but it doesn't really contain very much concrete gameplay information, we'd like to change this.

We want the 'Doctors handbook' to really be something of an [i]in-game wiki[/i], that will guide you through the entire game. In order to do this, it needs an overhaul and will be [u]significantly[/u] changed.

Above is a sketch of what is currently being tested, and shows how we ultimately want it to look like. It'll look more tidier and contain much more information, hopefully making it a reference table for all things Hospitalize.

All of the other windows the game offers will then have a [ ? ] in the top right, beside the [ X ] which will open up the corresponding page in the 'Doctors handbook'. Real nifty!

The [i]enhanced tutorial[/i] will incorporate this a lot.

Over to something else, we'll be creating a new branch of the game in steam, which will be an "experimental branch". This branch will get all updates much sooner than on the public branch, but [u]will contain bugs[/u]. 

This is for those who'd really like to get their hands on new content as soon as possible, but know the risk and would like to help with bugfixing. More on this later.

Super excited for the coming weeks, things will definitely go down! We'll see you then! :]

[h1][b]A tad bit late, but dev update #3 is here![/b][/h1]

But, it wouldn't be possible without the great help from you guys! Reporting everything you come across really helps us fine tune and fix anything that needs fixing. [b]High five![/b]

Easter is on the way and we're busy implementing some new stuff into the game that we hope you will enjoy.

Some of the issues we've seen arise on the forums, that we think everyone should have answered:

[list]
[*] [quote=Moe ilia]Do employees gain skills while working?? or only through contracts? [/quote]
[i] - Currently, employees only gain skills through contracts, but we're currently looking at a way to enhance this :][/i]

[*] [quote=Lubmos;135513901707095731]

It sends mails that a scan has failed and your reputation drops as a result. But both scans always seem to fail!

To boost my reputation again I dismantled both rooms, but I guess that's not the intended gameplay ;-) [/quote]
[i] - This issue is being looked at, and solution is to probably scale down the rep loss and the failrate until we've implemented the leveling of skills outside of contracts. We're also looking at a way to globally change all procedure speeds, so you can choose according to the skills of your staff.[/i]

[*] [quote=Patrick V;135513549100344515]Their is a lot of bugs that needs to be fixed. I am adding this as I go

You'll be able to see all the scheduled procedures; What doctor will do which task, choose general practitioner for patients, etc. These will be presented in a new calendar view. We hope you look forward to that!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update [26.03.2017] - Week one
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Good evening/afternoon/morning, Hospitalize Steam Forum![/b][/h1]

As stated in an earlier post last week here on the forum, we'll be doing [i]Weekly Dev Updates[/i] every week starting this week.

[b]Why?[/b] Much because we don't feel like you're being communicated with enough. Sure, we try to answer and help on the different threads, but it's hard for everyone to catch that, as only the person who creates the thread will have notifications of activity. 

So we think this is a good solution. With these updates we'll be going over [u]a few things:[/u]

[list]
[*] Insert some of the questions and answers in threads that were created that week that we feel the rest of the community should also know about.
[*] Give a little summary of what went down behind the scenes of future updates that was done that week. [i](This is probably the one you're most interested in, wink wink)[/i]
[*] Any info we see necessary that you get about what might've been going on that week.
[/list]

Right now, this is what we have in mind, but I'm sure that after doing it for a bit, we find more uses for these or maybe we have to change things around, we'll have to wait and see.

As you might know, a big update is coming up. There are a lot of new features and much change to the game from what it is at its current state. This is very exciting for us, actually a bit too exciting, so we're going to share some of the key features of [b]v.0.10.5.0:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Contracts[/b]. Contracts will help the player earn money and allow them to level up a certain staff member in a particular skill. [i]I.e. Surgery, Nursing.[/i]
[*] [b]New save & load system and GUI[/b]
[*] [b]Room environment & ambient variables[/b]. Patients will now get an impression of the looks of your hospital, making decorations more relevant. Patients will now also prefer less crowded rooms and will leave a bad impression if there aren't enough seats.
[*] [b]Cleaners[/b]. Cleaners replace Caretakers, turning Caretakers into explicit construction workers which will only arrive when something needs building.
[*] Along with this there are [b]new rooms, new objects, improved interface, improved options menu[/b] and much more!
[/list]

We really hope you're looking forward to it! It's been a while since we had an update going and are eager for you to get your hands on it.



[b]Thank you![/b]
 [i]- Illeris Team
